description: This file defines the CsvAutoDetect class used for detecting CSV file settings such as delimiter, enclosure, header presence, date and time formats within a SuiteCRM or SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for parsing CSV files, identifying configuration parameters, and recognizing data formats.

classes.name: CsvAutoDetect
classes.description: Class to detect CSV file settings including delimiter, enclosure, header, date, and time formats.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CsvAutoDetect instance with a filename and maximum CSV parse depth.

methods.name: getCsvSettings
methods.description: Attempts to detect the CSV delimiter and enclosure by parsing the file and analyzing data patterns.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if the CSV file has a header row matching the module's field definitions.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Analyzes CSV data to identify a format that matches known date or time regex patterns.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Detects the date format used in the CSV data.

methods.name: getTimeFormat
methods.description: Detects the time format used in the CSV data.
